window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged and returned little dated inside the window; items below were announced 9 November and describe actions from 5 to 8 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements could be verified.

stories.headline: Wiretap case in New York City: ex-NYPD detective among four arrested over fentanyl, crack and heroin sales plus 13 illegal guns
stories.body: The city's Special Narcotics Prosecutor and the NYPD announced on 9 November that raids on 5 November in Washington Heights, Great Kills and Eltingville turned up fentanyl, crack, heroin, a pill press and 13 unlicensed firearms. Prosecutors say the alleged ringleader and a retired detective were part of a group trying to supply Upper Manhattan and Staten Island; the case followed a wiretap that began in May. No drug weights were reported.
stories.location: Manhattan and Staten Island, New York

stories.headline: Mexico captures alleged Jalisco cartel cell chief 'R2' in Zapopan using DEA intelligence
stories.body: On 8 November Mexican forces arrested Rafael Alvarez, said to lead the CJNG cell known as Los Rs, in the Guadalajara area after a shootout in which he was wounded; 19 others were detained. Security Minister Omar Garcia Harfuch linked the cell to extortion, trafficking and homicides, and Alvarez faces a US extradition request. No drugs were reported seized.
